# WPMN Design System

> AI-friendly component library and CSS design token system for WPManageNinja products (FluentForms, FluentCRM, NinjaTables, and 13 more WordPress plugin brands). Plain CSS custom properties + React, no build step. 16 brands switch via a single `data-brand` attribute.

This file tells AI agents how to fetch and use this design system.

## How to use this repo as an AI agent

1. Fetch `registry.json` first. It lists every component, its files, variants, and interactions.
2. For each component you need, choose ONE of two paths:
   - **Prompt path**: fetch the component's `prompt.md` and follow it as a build spec to recreate the component in any stack (HTML/CSS, React, Vue, etc.). Specs are exact: px values, token names, states, transition timings.
   - **Code path**: fetch the component's source files (`.jsx` + `.css`) and use them as-is. They depend only on the token CSS files.
3. Always load the token files before using any component code:
   - `primitives.css` (raw values) -> `brand-primitives.css` (brand overrides) -> `tokens.css` (semantic tokens) -> `typography.css` (type scale). Or just `index.css` which imports all four in order.
4. Components must only use semantic tokens (`--color-*`, `--btn-*`, `--input-*`, `--radius-*`, `--font-*`, `--shadow-*`). Never hardcode colors and never use `--primitive-*` directly in new component code.

All files are fetchable via raw URLs:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/<path>`

## Core rules

- Brand switching: set `data-brand="<key>"` on the root or any section. Keys: wpmanagenia, fluentforms, fluentcrm, ninjatables, wpsocialninja, fluentsupport, fluentaffiliate, fluentboards, fluentcart, fluentplayer, fluentmembers, fluentbooking, fluentcommunity, paymattic, fluentsmtp, azonpress.
- Dark mode: add `data-theme="dark"` to `<html>`. Light is default.
- Mobile: handled automatically via `@media (max-width: 768px)`.
- Font: Work Sans (400/500/600/700), loaded by `typography.css`.
- Buttons: always pair primary + secondary side by side on marketing pages.
- JSX convention: use `var`, not `const`, inside function bodies. Icons are inline SVG path data, no runtime imports.

## Key files

- [registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/registry.json): machine-readable component index. START HERE.
- [index.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/index.css): single import for the full token system.
- [tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/tokens.css): semantic tokens (light/dark/mobile).
- [brand-primitives.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/brand-primitives.css): all 16 brand color scales.
- [typography.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/typography.css): type scale + utility classes.
- [wpmn-design-guideline.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/wpmn-design-guideline.md): layout, spacing, section, and logo rules for full pages.

## Components

Each component folder contains: source files, `meta.json` (machine spec), `prompt.md` (AI build spec).

- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Button/prompt.md): 3 types x 5 sizes x 5 states, loading spinner
- [Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Input/prompt.md): stroke/fill variants, 3 sizes, error/success states
- [Badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Badge/prompt.md): pill/soft variants, 5 semantic types
- [Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Text/prompt.md): polymorphic typography component, 12 variants
- [NavBar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/NavBar/prompt.md): responsive nav with mobile drawer
- [Logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Logo/prompt.md): 16 brands x logo/icon x 5 color types, inline SVG
- [Footer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Footer/prompt.md): full site footer with nav columns and social icons
- [Breadcrumbs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/Breadcrumbs/prompt.md): 4 style variants, light + dark
- [SocialIcons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/components/SocialIcons/prompt.md): 7 platform icons, sizable button group

## Optional

- [demo.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/demo.html): browser demo of all components (Babel standalone, no build).
- [library.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/master/library.html): human-facing library browser with Copy Prompt / Copy Code buttons.
- [docs/](https://github.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens/tree/master/docs): per-topic markdown docs (brands, colors, components, icons, layout, logo, spacing, tokens, typography).
